name: Px Oatmilk Latte
caffeineNote: Decaffeinated base; the 60 mg the brand prints is paraxanthine (Px), not caffeine, and no caffeine figure is published
summary: Cold brew oatmilk latte from the Px line, built on decaffeinated coffee with 60 mg of paraxanthine added per can — a caffeine metabolite Rarebird sells as steadier energy, not caffeine. Its caffeine column is blank because the base is decaf and no residual figure is published; Rarebird states no can size or nutrition panel either.
